scientific.integrity: The primary open PDF was inspected at the map, coexistence conditions, Jacobian, characteristic polynomial, and Lemma 3. A separate open full-text predator-prey paper was inspected for a standard root-based classification. The bundled checker replays the exact witness algebra; the classification proof is analytic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding corrects the local trace-determinant classification lemma for the published discrete map. It does not assess the paper's later center-manifold coefficients, bifurcation directions, control calculations, or numerical diagrams. The explicit witness is mathematically admissible rather than a fitted ecological parameter set.

title: An admissible saddle contradicts the source criterion in a Ricker predator–prey stability lemma
